v: pu॰ prati + ud + gama--GaY na vfdDiH । 1 pratyutTAne (AvAqAyAoyA) pratigamane 2 ca BAve lyuw । pratyudgamana tatrArTe na॰ ।
m: प्रत्य्-˚उद्गम m. (Ragh. &c.) going forth towards, rising from a seat (as a mark of respect) and going out to meet (esp. a guest).

v: na॰ prati + ud + gama--anIyar । 1 DOtayastrayagmo amaraH “gfhItapratyudgamanIyavastrA” iti kumAre pAWAntaraM prahre veti na gurutvam । 2 sumupasyAnayogye pUjaniye ca tri॰
m: प्रत्य्-˚उद्गमनीय mfn. to be met or treated respectfully, L.
fit or suitable for the respectful salutation of a guest, Kum.
प्रत्य्-˚उद्गमनीय n. a clean suit of clothes, the upper and lower garments as worn at meals &c., L.
a: प्रत्युद्गमनीयं — A clean pair of garments; गृहीतप्रत्युद्गमनीयवस्त्रा Ku. 7. 11 (v. l. for ˚पत्युद्गमनीय˚); see उद्गमनीय.

s: klI, (prati + ut + gam + lyuw .) pratyutTAnam । (yaTA, praboDacandrodaye 2 aNke । “Aryya ! pratyAsanno mahArAjaH । tatpratyudgamanena saMBAvyatAmAryyeRa ॥”)
m: प्रत्य्-˚उद्गमन n. (Prab.) going forth towards, rising from a seat (as a mark of respect) and going out to meet (esp. a guest).
प्रत्य्-˚उद्गत mfn. gone to meet (a friend or an enemy), MBh.
met, encountered, R.; Ragh.
risen as from a seat, W.
a: प्रत्युद्गत — p. p. 1 Risen from one's seat as a mark of respect to greet or welcome a guest; प्रत्युद्गतो मां भरतः ससैन्यः R. 13. 64; 12. 62. --2 Gone forth against.

m: प्रत्य्-˚उद्गति f. (Kād. &c.) going forth towards, rising from a seat (as a mark of respect) and going out to meet (esp. a guest).
a: प्रत्युद्गतिः — f., प्रत्युद्गमः, प्रत्युद्गमनं Going out or rising from one's seat to meet or greet a guest.

m: प्रत्य्-उद्-√ ग्रह् P. -गृह्णाति, to set aside, dismiss, Lāṭy.
प्रत्य्-˚उद्ग्रह m.
प्रत्य्-˚उद्ग्रहण n. setting aside, dismissing, ib., Sch.
प्रत्य्-उद्-√ इ P. -एति, to ascend to (acc.), AV.; to rise and go towards (acc.), ib. &c.
प्रत्य्-उदित mfn. rejected, repelled, BhP., Sch.
प्रत्य्-उदित See प्रति-√ वद्.
प्रत्य्-उद्-√ वद् Caus. -वादयति, to cause to resound, ŚBr.
प्रत्य्-उद्-√ व्रज् P. -व्रजति, to go forth to meet, Ragh.
प्रत्य्-उद्-√ या P. -याति, to rise and go towards or against, go to meet (a friend or an enemy), MBh.; Kāv. &c.
प्रत्य्-˚उद्यामिन् mfn. id., resisting, refractory, AitBr.; ŚBr.
प्रत्य्-˚उद्यान n. the act of going forth against &c., L.
प्रत्य्-˚उद्यात mfn. met, encountered, received, Kālid.
a: प्रत्युद्यात — a. See प्रत्युद्गत.

m: प्रत्य्-˚उद्यातृ mfn. going forth against, attacking an assailant, MBh.
प्रत्य्-उद्-√ यम् P. -यच्छति, to counterbalance (acc.), TāṇḍBr.
प्रत्य्-˚उद्यम m. (TāṇḍBr.), आ, f. (ŚāṅkhBr.) counterbalance, equipoise.
a: प्रत्युद्यम — 1 Counterbalance, counterpoise. --2 An effort or measure against, counteraction; Bh. 3. 88 v. l.

m: प्रत्य्-˚उद्यमिन् mfn. maintaining an equipoise, counterbalancing, ŚāṅkhBr.
प्रत्य्-˚उद्यत mfn. presented, offered, BhP.
w.r. for ˚उद्गत.
प्रत्य्-उज्-√ जीव् (-उद्-√ जीव्) P. -जीवति, to return to life, revive, Ratnāv.; Kathās. : Caus. -जीवयति, to restore to life, revivify, resuscitate, Pañcat.
a: प्रत्युज्जीव् — {c1c} P. To revive, return to life. --Caus. To restore or bring to life.

v: na॰ prati + ud + jIva--BAve lyuw । punarjIvane maraRottaraM punarjIvane । “rasavicCedahetutvAt maraRaM nEva varRyate । varRyate'pi yadi pratyujjIvanaM syAdadUrataH” sA॰ da॰ । yaTA kAdambarIgranTe tadvarRanam ।
m: प्रत्य्-˚उज्जीवन n. returning to life, reviving, MBh.; Kād.; Bālar.
(fr. Caus.) restoring to life, revivifying, MBh.; Kād.
a: प्रत्युज्जीवनं — 1 Reviving, restoring to life, resuscitation (fig. also). --2 Coming to life.

v: tri॰ prati + vaca--karmaRi kta । 1 uttarite prativAvAkyena 2 nirAkfte ca ।
m: प्रत्य्-उक्त mfn. answered (pers. and thing), Br.; MBh. &c.
प्रत्य्-उक्त n. = next, Megh.
प्रत्य्-उक्त See प्रति-√ वच्, p. 670.
a: प्रत्युक्त — p. p. Answered, said in return, replied.

s: strI, (prativacanamiti । prati + vac + BAve ktin । pratirUpA uktiriti vA .) pratyuttaram । iti SabdaratnAvalI ॥
v: strI prati + vaca--BAve ktin । prativAkyakaTane Sabdara॰
m: प्रत्य्-उक्ति f. an answer, Satr.
a: प्रत्युक्तिः — f. A reply, an answer.

m: प्रत्य्-√ उक्ष् P. -उक्षति, to sprinkle, ĀpŚr.

m: प्रत्य्—उलूक m. a bird resembling an owl
(according to the Sch.) a hostile owl or a crow regarded as an owl's enemy, BhP.
प्रत्य्—उलूकक m. a bird resembling an owl, Hariv.
प्रत्य्-उन्-√ मिष् (-उद्- √ 1. मिष्) P. -मिषति, to rise or shine forth (as the sun), Daś.

v: na॰ pratikUtamunnamana prA॰ sa॰ । unnamanapratikUle avanamane । “aNgulyA'vapIqite pratyunnaBanam” suSrutavraRacikitsANgakriyoktO ।
m: प्रत्य्-उन्-नमन n. (√ नम्) rising or springing up again, rebounding, Suśr.
a: प्रत्युन्नमनं — Rising or springing up again, rebounding.

m: प्रत्य्-उपा-√ 1. धा Ā. -धत्ते, to regain, recover, BhP.
प्रत्य्-उपा-√ हृ P. -हरति, to give up, desist, MBh.
प्रत्य्-उपा-करण n. (√ 1. कृ) recommencement of Vedic study, Gobh.
प्रत्य्—उपासनम् ind. for every kind of worship, Bādar., Sch.
प्रत्य्˚उपभोग m. enjoyment, MārkP.
प्रत्य्-उप-√ 2. भुज् Ā. -भुङ्क्ते, to eat, enjoy, R.
प्रत्य्-उप-√ 1. धा P. -दधाति, to put or place upon, cover, ŚBr.

v: pu॰ pratirUpaH upadeSaH prA॰ sa॰ । 1 upadeSakasya prAptopadeSena kfte SikzABede kumA॰ 1 । 34
m: प्रत्य्-˚उपदेश m. instruction or advice in return, Kum.
a: प्रत्युपदेशः — Advice in return; Ku. 1. 34.

m: प्रत्य्-उप-√ दिश् P. -दिशति to explain singly or severally, Suśr.; to teach anything (acc.) in return to (dat.), Mālav.
प्रत्य्-˚उपदिष्ट mfn. advised or cautioned in return, MW.
प्रत्य्-उप-√ द्रु P. -द्रवति, to rush against, fall upon, assail (acc.), MBh.; Pañcat.
प्रत्य्-उप-√ गम् P. -गच्छति, to come near, approach, MW.
प्रत्य्-˚उपगत mfn. come near, approached, ib.

v: pu॰ pratirUpa upahAraH prA॰ sa॰ । anurUpe upahAre upaQokanoye dravye ।
m: प्रत्य्-उप-हार m. (√ हृ) handing back, restitution, Ragh.
a: प्रत्युपहारः — 1 A respectful offering. --2 Giving back, restoring.

m: प्रत्य्-˚उपहव m. a response to an invitatory formula or the repetition of it, ib.; ĀśvŚr.
प्रत्य्-उप-√ ह्वे Ā. -हवते, to call, invite, Br.

v: pu॰ pratirUpaH upakAraH pA॰ sa॰ । 1 kftApakAreRa kfte upakArakasya upakArAturUpe hitAcaraRe ।
m: प्रत्य्-˚उपकार m. returning a service or favour, gratitude, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
a: प्रत्युपकारः — 1 Returning a service or kindness, requital of an obligation, service in return. --2 Mutual assistance.

m: प्रत्य्-˚उपकारिन् mfn. requiting a favour, grateful, R.
प्रत्य्-उप-√ कृ Ā. -कुरुते, to do a service in return, requite a favour, Pañcat.
a: प्रत्युपकृ — {c8c} U. 1 To requite a favour, render a service in return. --2 To repay.

m: प्रत्य्-उप-√ क्रम् Ā. -क्रमते, to go or march forth against (acc.), GopBr.
प्रत्य्-˚उपक्रिया f. = ˚उपकार, Kād.; Rājat.; Kathās.
a: प्रत्युपक्रिया — Return of a service.

m: प्रत्य्-उप-लब्ध mfn. (√ लभ्) gained back, recovered, Vikr.; BhP.
a: प्रत्युपलब्ध — p. p. Got back, recovered.

m: प्रत्य्-उप-लब्ध—चेतस् mfn. one who has recovered his senses, MW.
प्रत्य्—उपमान n. a counter comparison, the ideal of an ideal, Vikr.
a: प्रत्युपमानं — 1 A counterpart of a resemblance. --2 A pattern, model. --3 A counter-comparison; V. 2. 3.

m: प्रत्य्-उप-पन्न v.l. for प्रत्युत्पन्न, in -मति, ˚ति-त्व, Śak. v, 19/20.
a: प्रत्युपपन्न — a. See प्रत्युत्पन्न.

m: प्रत्य्-उप-रुद्ध mfn. (√ 2. रुध्) obstructed, choked, BhP.
प्रत्य्-उप-√ स्था P. Ā. तिष्ठति, ˚ते, (Ā.) to stand opposite to, ŚBr.; (Ā.) to wait on MBh. ; (P.) to insist on (loc.), Vajracch. : Caus. -स्थापयति, to call forth, manifest, Śaṃk.
प्रत्य्-˚उपस्थान n. proximity, imminence, Śaṃk.
a: प्रत्युपस्थानं — Vicinity, neighbourhood.

m: प्रत्य्-˚उपस्थापन n. mental realization, ib.
प्रत्य्-उपस्थित mfn. come near to (acc.), approached, arrived, MBh.; Hariv. &c.
standing or being in (loc. or comp.), Hariv.; Var.
present, assisting at (loc.), SaddhP.
gone against, standing opposite to (acc.), MBh.
assembled, ib.
happened, occurred (or about to happen, imminent), MBh.; Kāv. &c.
collecting, pressing (as urine), Suśr.
प्रत्य्—उपसदम् ind. at each celebration of an Upasad, KātyŚr.
प्रत्य्-उप-√ सृ P. -सरति, to return, BhP.
प्रत्य्-˚उपस्पर्शन n. touching or sipping (water) again, ib.
प्रत्य्-उप-√ स्पृश् P. -स्पृशति, to touch or sip again (water for internal ablution), Gobh.
प्रत्य्-˚उपवेश m. besetting or besieging a person (to make him yield), R.
a: प्रत्युपवेशः, --वेशनं — Besetting any one in order to bring him to compliance.

m: प्रत्य्-उप-वे˚शन n. besetting or besieging a person (to make him yield), R.

प्रत्य्-उप-√ विश् P. -विशति, to sit down opposite to or before (acc.); to beset or besiege a person (to make him yield), MBh.; R. : Caus. -वेशयते, to cause a person to beset or besiege another, Āpast.; to oppose, resist, R.
प्रत्य्-˚उपविष्ट mfn. one who besets or besieges another, Āpast.
प्रत्य्-उप-√ व्रज् P. -व्रजति, to go against, attack (acc.), MBh.
प्रत्य्-उप-√ या P. -याति, to go again towards, return, MBh.
प्रत्य्-उपे (-उप-√ इ) P. -उपैति, to approach again, recommence, AitBr.; Kauś.
प्रत्य्-उपेक्षित mfn. (√ ईक्ष्) disregarded, neglected, R.
प्रत्य्-˚उपेय mfn. to be met or dealt with, MBh.
प्रत्य्-उपोदित mfn. (√ वद्) addressed with offensive words, TāṇḍBr.
प्रत्य्-उप्त mfn. fixed into (loc.), Uttarar.
(ifc.) set with, Daś.
प्रत्य्-उप्त See प्रति-√ वप्, p. 670.
a: प्रत्युप्त — p. p. 1 Inlaid, set with, studded. --2 Sown. --3 Fixed, implanted. firmly fixed or lodged; Māl. 5. 10; U. 3. 35, 46.

v: avya॰ urasi viBaktyarTe'vyayI॰ । “praterurasaH saptamIsTAt” pA॰ ac samA॰ । urasItyarTe । saptamIsTAdityukteH lakzaRAdyarTa praterna ac । pratyuras ityeba ।
m: प्रत्य्—उरस n. = प्रतिगतम् उरः, Vop.
प्रत्य्—उरसम् ind. against the breast, upon the b˚, Śiś.; Kir. (cf. Pāṇ. v, 4, 82).
प्रत्य्-उत्-था (√ स्था) P. -तिष्ठति to rise up before (acc.), rise to salute, go to meet, Br.; Mn.; MBh. &c.

s: klI, (pratyutTIyate iti । prati + ut + sTA + lyuw .) aByutTAnam । gAtrotTAnam । yaTA, -- “dIvyantamakzEstatrApi priyayA codDavena ca । pUjitaH parayA BaktyA pratyutTAnAsanAdiBiH ॥” iti SrIBAgavate । 10 । 69 । 20 ॥
v: na॰ prati + ud + sTA--lyuw । aByutTAne Agatasya sammAnanArTamAsanAdutTitO “prayutTAnABivAdaByAM punastatpratipadyate” anuH ।
m: प्रत्य्-˚उत्थान n. rising from a seat to welcome a visitor, respectful salutation or reception, Mn.; Gaut.; MBh. &c.
rising up against, hostility, Hariv. (v.l. अभ्य्-उत्थ्˚).
a: प्रत्युत्थानं — 1 Rising against. --2 Making preparations for war. --3 Rising from one's seat (as a mark of respect) to welcome a visitor; Ms. 2. 210. --4 Making preparations for, undertaking.

m: प्रत्य्-˚उत्थायिक v.l. (or w.r.) for ˚युक.
प्रत्य्-˚उत्थायिन् mfn. rising again, ŚBr.
प्रत्य्-˚उत्थायुक mfn. rising respectfully (अ-प्रत्युत्थ्˚), GopBr.; ŚrS. (v.l. ˚यिक).
प्रत्य्-˚उत्थेय mfn. to be honoured or saluted by rising from the seat, AitBr.
प्रत्य्-˚उत्थित mfn. risen to meet (acc.), MBh.; R.
a: प्रत्युत्थित — p. p. Risen to meet or encounter (a friend, foe &c.).

s: vya, (prati ca uta ca iti dvandraH .) vEparItyam । yaTA । buDAdivAkyaM tu na niyAmakaM pramARABAvAt pratyuta PalaSruterguRaPalaboDakamiti । iti tiTyAditattve janmAzwamIprakaraRam ॥ (yaTA, mArkaRqeye । 95 । 20 । “vihitAkaraRAt puMBirasadBiH kriyate tu yaH । saMyamo muktaye so'nte pratyutADogatipradaH ॥”)
v: avya॰ prati--uta dva॰ । 1 svapakzasTApanAya parapakzanirAkaraRAya vA uktasya tadvEparItyaBAve 2 vEparItyamAtre ca “na dozaH punaruktA'pi pratyuteyamalaNkriyA” kAvyAda॰ ।
m: प्रत्य्—उत See p. 677.
प्रत्य्-उत ind. on the contrary, rather, even, Kāv.; Kathās.; Pur. &c. (cf. 2. उत).
a: प्रत्युत — ind. 1 On the contrary; कृतमपि महोपकारं पय इव पीत्वा निरातंकः . प्रत्युत हंतुं यतते काकोदरमोदरः खलो जगति Bv. 1. 76. --2 Rather, even. --3 On the other hand.

m: प्रत्य्-उत्-कर्ष m. (√ कृष्) outdoing, surpassing, Pratāp.
प्रत्य्-˚उत्क्रान्त mfn. about to pass away
प्रत्य्-˚उत्क्रान्त—जीवित mfn. one whose life is about to pass away, almost dead, Daś.

s: strI, (prati + ut + kram + ktin .) pratyutkramaH । ityamarawIkAyAM kzIrasvAmI ॥
m: प्रत्य्-˚उत्क्रान्ति f. = -उत्क्रम, L.

s: puM, (pratyutkramaRamiti । prati + ut + kram + GaY .) praGAnaprayojanAnukUlaprayojanAnuzWAnam । tatparyyAyaH । prayogArTaH 2 । ityamaraH ॥ prakfzwayogaH । iti kecit । prakfzwayadDArTamupakramaH prayogaH tadvAcyaH । iti kecit । prayogo yudDaM tadaBiDeya iti kecit । pratyutkramo yudDArTa iti BAguriH । yudDArTaM praTamAkrAntiH । ityapare । karmmAramBe praTamayuktiH prayogaH । ityapare ॥ iti BarataH ॥

m: प्रत्य्-उत्-क्रम m. (√ क्रम्) undertaking, the first step or measure in any business, L.
setting out to assail an enemy, W.
declaration of war, W.
a: प्रत्युत्क्रमः, --क्रमणं, --क्रांतिः — f. 1 An undertaking. --2 Preparations for war. --3 Marching out to attack an enemy. --4 A secondary act or effort tending to a main object. --5 The first step in any business.

k.v: प्रत्युत्क्रमः प्रयोगार्थः प्रक्रमः स्यादुपक्रमः। स्यादभ्यादानमुद्धात आरम्भः सम्भ्रमस्त्वरा॥

m: प्रत्य्-˚उत्क्रमण n. id., W.
प्रत्य्-उत्-√ 5. पा Ā. -पिपीते, to rise against (acc.), TS.

s: tri, (prati + ut + pad + ktaH .) utpattiviSizwaH । pratyutpUrvvapadDAtoH karttari ktapratyayena nizpannaH ॥
m: प्रत्य्-उत्-पन्न mfn. (√ पद्) existing at the present moment, present, prompt, ready, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
reproduced, regenerated, W.
(in arithm.) produced by multiplication, multiplied, Col.
प्रत्य्-उत्-पन्न n. multiplication or the product of a sum in m˚, ib.
